newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Alpargatas to focus on core business.
newsitem.headline: Alpargatas to focus on core business.

text.p: Argentine textile and footwear company Alpargatas plans to sell non-core assets and concentrate on its main business to be in a more competitive position by 2000, vice president Guillermo Gotelli was quoted Wednesday as saying.
According to La Nacion newspaper, he said the company plans "to sell assets not related to the central businesses (some plants and real estate) and exploit others adequately."
He added Alpargatas is considering issuing a long-term bond to smooth that transition. No further details were available.
Gotelli said last year Alpargatas cancelled debt of some $120 million, including $50 million in interest.
"We're penalized by the Argentine financial system," he said. "But we're aware that until we show that we can cancel debt with genuine funds, that prejudice won't change."
